name: yeahbase-jobs
description: Search the public job ads on Yeahbase, a job marketplace for sales roles in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and read any ad in full. Employers see how many sales candidates the candidate search holds, as rounded sums. Read-only, no account needed.

interface.shortDescription: Sales jobs in DE, AT and CH
interface.longDescription:
Yeahbase is a job marketplace based in Germany that serves the whole German-speaking region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Almost all of its ads are for sales roles such as closers, setters and sales representatives, most of them remote. It also takes ads in care, skilled trades and other fields. This app lets ChatGPT search the ads that are publicly visible on yeahbase.com and read any of them in full. For employers, it tells how many sales candidates the candidate search on yeahbase.com holds.

What you can do:
- Search ads by keyword, category, workplace (remote, hybrid, on-site), place and employment type, with labels in German or English.
- Open one ad with its description, tasks, pay as stated in the ad, workplace, location, languages, experience and application deadline.
- See which filter values exist and how many ads each one has right now.
- As an employer, see how many sales profiles the candidate search holds, by German federal state, workplace preference, employment type, years of experience, language and skill.

Every result links to yeahbase.com: an ad to the page where applications are made, the candidate figures to the page where employers post a job ad. The app only reads: it cannot apply, post or change anything, and it needs no account.

For ads, it returns only what the public ad pages show. It never returns a candidate profile, a candidate's name or contact details, or employers' internal contact addresses. Candidate figures are sums only: every number is rounded down, and a group appears from 100 profiles on. Ads come in neutral order, newest first, with no paid placement.

Many ads are written in German.
defaultPrompt: Find remote closer or setter jobs on Yeahbase and show me the newest ones.
Open the newest remote sales job on Yeahbase in full, including the pay and how to apply.
I'm hiring sales reps in Germany. How many candidates could a job ad on Yeahbase reach?

positive.prompt: Find remote sales jobs on Yeahbase.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of current ads with title, company, workplace, pay as stated and a link to each ad on yeahbase.com, newest first.

positive.prompt: Which job categories and workplaces does Yeahbase have, and how many ads are in each?
positive.expected_behavior: Every category, workplace and employment type with its current number of public ads, plus the total.

positive.prompt: Open the newest remote sales job on Yeahbase in full, including the pay and how to apply.
positive.expected_behavior: The full ad (description, tasks, pay, workplace, location, experience, deadline) and the yeahbase.com link where applications are made.

positive.prompt: I'm hiring sales reps in Germany. How many sales candidates can I reach on Yeahbase, by federal state and skill?
positive.expected_behavior: The rounded total of sales profiles in the yeahbase.com candidate search and its breakdown by federal state, workplace preference, employment type, experience, language and skill, each group from 100 profiles on, with the link to the page where employers post a job ad. No name, profile or contact detail.

positive.description: Employment type filter with English labels
positive.prompt: Show me freelance commission-based sales jobs on Yeahbase, with labels in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Matching ads with English labels for workplace, employment type and pay; the ad texts keep their original language.

negative.prompt: Apply to this job for me with my CV.

negative.description: Individual candidate profiles are not available
negative.prompt: Give me the names and contact details of sales candidates on Yeahbase.
What's the weather in Munich today?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads public job ads and sums over candidate profiles.

publication.release_notes: Adds get_candidate_figures for employers: how many sales candidates the yeahbase.com candidate search holds, by federal state, workplace preference, employment type, experience, language and skill, as rounded sums from 100 profiles on, without any individual profile.
